It would leave out money terms and finance documents, since those go only to the CFO, the deal desk and the account owner. Operational items like meetings, tickets and seat counts would stay in.

Someone with admin access to the Gateway will need to restore the scheduler credentials. Once that's done, ask me again and I'll set it up. I can also post today's #coastal-team updates here in the meantime if that helps.
